## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      9 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 20, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Pamela Henshaw_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "Extremely DISAPPOINTED. I did the trial period for this APP and canceled it quickly. Weeks later I received a message stating that my trial period was over and I would be billed. I emailed expressing my concerns and got a messages stating that yes, my trial and subscription had been canceled and then the next day got billed for it. Back and forth emails all stating that I was canceled but now they are saying I hadn't canceled before I was billed."
            2. _Stephany Cumahling_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "i just subscribe on this application i want cancel future renewal after paying for a month subscription but why i cant open manage subscriptions? and always oops somethings wrong?"
            3. _Dylan Leslie_, Sep 28, 2026, 1/5: "just a money flip. answer loads of questions and sign up for a week trial. then they say they want 25 A MONTH! for body weight exercises 😂 then before the app has still showed me anything it's trying to sell me add ons for abs. couldn't care how good the app is, 2.50 for body weight app I understand but u want the price of a gym membership😂😂 immediately cancelled"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Archie-Val Pangilinan_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up and paid for this because I thought there would be kegel exercises program but there was none! The app is soooo slow. Waste of money"
            2. _Engin Volkan_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
